3.2.0.headline: Your sleep confirm window moved.
3.2.0.detail: It now opens 30 minutes after you press Wake and stays open for 30 minutes. Your night and wake windows are untouched. Starts tomorrow.

3.2.0.headline: Grace is now yours to spend.
3.2.0.detail: Two a month for each activity you track, used on whichever streak you choose after it breaks. It still only holds a streak: fines and standing are untouched. Settings shows how many you have left.
